music-missing-publication-date-contribut: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the musical release's first publication date.

This musical release doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the publication date information by adding the date when this musical release was first published or released, e.g. 30 November 1982
music-missing-record-label-contribution-: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the record label name and select the available related Wikidata item.

This musical release doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the record label information by adding the brand or trademark associated with the marketing of this musical release, e.g. Big Brother Recordings, Epic Records, XL Recordings. Note that not every musical release is associated with a record label. Self-released recordings may have no label or formal marketing brand, so only add this statement when a record label can be reliably identified.
music-missing-language-contribution-summ: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the primary language used in the musical release and select the available related Wikidata item.
music-missing-language-contribution-deta: This musical release doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the language of work or name information by adding the language spoken in this musical release, e.g. English, Korean, German.
music-missing-title-contribution-summary: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the official title of this musical release and select the correct language tag.
music-missing-title-contribution-details: This musical release doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the title information by adding the title in the language it was originally released in and selecting the matching language tag, e.g. Future Nostalgia, LOVE YOURSELF 承 'Her', El Mal Querer.
music-missing-performer-contribution-sum: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the performer's name and select the available related Wikidata item.
music-missing-performer-contribution-det: This musical release doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the performer information by adding the name of the person or group that performed this musical release, e.g. Adele, Rosalía, The Weeknd.
podcasts-missing-language-contribution-s: Add a statement for the property $1. Fill in the primary language used in the podcast and select the available related Wikidata item.
podcasts-missing-language-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1. Complete the language information by adding the language spoken in this podcast, e.g. English, Korean, German.
podcasts-missing-genre-contribution-summ: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the genre that best describes this podcast and select the available related Wikidata item.
podcasts-missing-genre-contribution-deta: This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the genre information by adding a suitable genre for this podcast, e.g. true crime, comedy, interview.
podcasts-missing-presenter-contribution-: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the presenter's name and select the available related Wikidata item.

This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the presenter information by adding the name of the person who hosts this podcast, e.g. Laélia Véron or Doug Lussenhop and select the available related Wikidata Item. If the podcast has more than one presenter, add each additional presenter as a separate $1 statement.
podcasts-missing-producer-contribution-s: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the producer's name and select the available related Wikidata item.
podcasts-missing-producer-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the producer information by adding the name of the person who produced this podcast, e.g. Robert Evans, Andrew Sherman, or Marnie Silverman and select the available related Wikidata Item. If the podcast has more than one producer, add each additional producer as a separate $1 statement.
podcasts-missing-production-company-cont: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the production company's name and select the available related Wikidata item.

This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the production company information by adding the name of the company that produced this podcast, e.g. Nederlandse Omroep Stichting, Spotify Studios, or SAS Tip & Shaft.
podcasts-missing-official-website-contri: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the URL of the website that represents this podcast.
This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the official website information by adding the URL of the podcast's official website.
podcasts-missing-feed-url-contribution-s: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the URL of the podcast's web feed.
podcasts-missing-feed-url-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the web feed information by adding a valid feed URL.
paintings-missing-creator-contribution-s: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the creator's name and select the available related Wikidata item.
paintings-missing-creator-contribution-d: This painting doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the creator information by adding the name of the person who created this painting, e.g. Leonardo da Vinci, Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer.
paintings-missing-material-contribution-: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the painting's material and select the available related Wikidata item.

This painting doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the material information by adding the materials used to create this painting, e.g. oil paint, poplar panel, wood. If the painting has more than one material, add each additional material as a separate $1 statement.
paintings-missing-inception-contribution: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the painting's inception date.
This painting doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the inception information by adding the painting's creation date, e.g. 1665, 1930, 1642.
paintings-missing-genre-contribution-sum: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the genre that best describes this painting and select the available related Wikidata item.
paintings-missing-genre-contribution-det: This painting doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the genre information by adding a suitable genre for this painting, e.g. marine art, mythological painting, still life.
paintings-missing-collection-contributio: Add a statement for the property $1 statement. Fill in the painting's collection and select the available related Wikidata item.

This painting doesn't have a statement for the property $1 statement. Complete the collection information by adding the collection that holds this painting, e.g. National Gallery, Art Institute of Chicago, Museum of Modern Art.
